description: This file defines the SiloStatusOracle class, which implements the ISiloStatusOracle interface. It manages silo status information within the Orleans runtime, including caching silo statuses, retrieving active silos, and subscribing to silo status events.

classes.name: SiloStatusOracle
classes.description: Implements silo status management, including caching and event subscription within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: SiloStatusOracle
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SiloStatusOracle with dependencies.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatus
methods.description: Returns the approximate status of a specified silo.

methods.name: GetActiveSilos
methods.description: Returns an immutable array of active silo addresses.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatuses
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of silo statuses, filtered by active status if specified.

methods.name: EnsureFreshCache
methods.description: Updates the cached silo status information if outdated.

methods.name: IsDeadSilo
methods.description: Checks if a specified silo is dead.

methods.name: IsFunctionalDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a specified silo is a functional directory.

methods.name: TryGetSiloName
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the name of a specified silo.

methods.name: SubscribeToSiloStatusEvents
methods.description: Subscribes a listener to silo status events.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromSiloStatusEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes a listener from silo status events.

methods.name: LogSiloAddressNotRegistered
methods.description: Logs a debug message when a silo address is not registered.
